podcast.body: This was the last full, proper song recorded by Nirvana, officially released after a lawsuit over its distribution was resolved. The song was originally untitled by Kurt Cobain, referred to as "Kurt's song number one" in studio notes. "You Know Your Right, The Last Full, Proper Song, Recorded by Nirvana."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: "You Know Your Right" is noted as Nirvana's last ever completed song. It was recorded at Robert Lang Studios, located north of Seattle, a studio also used by the Foo Fighters and a favorite of Alice in Chains. "Nirvana recorded, you know your right. Their last ever completed song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Following Kurt Cobain's death, this was identified as "the only truly finished thing" that turned up from his remaining work. "The only truly finished thing that turned up was the song You Know Your Right."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
